ns2:section.sectionText: This seminar guides students to read modern Chinese literature through applying different literary theories and critical ideas to understanding the text, the context, and the historical conditions. In this seminar, various literary and critical theories, ranging from new criticism and structuralism to new historicism and post-colonialism, are introduced. We will also read literary texts, rendered as a platform where literary theories and criticism are tested and understood. Primary texts in Chinese, and secondary literature in both English and Chinese.
